chunks: From him, from Wahb ibn Hafs, from Abu Baseer, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them) regarding the divorced woman.

Where should she observe her waiting period? He said: In her house. If it is a revocable divorce (raj'ah) for him over her, it is not for him to expel her, nor for her to leave, until her waiting period (iddah) is completed.

key_terms.رَجْعَة: Revocable divorce (where the husband can take her back without a new contract)

ai.seo_question: Where should a divorced woman stay during her waiting period if the divorce is revocable?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Abu Basir, clarifies the specific legal status of a woman in a revocable divorce (talaq raj'i), emphasizing that the marital bond remains partially intact. It establishes that the wife is entitled to housing and cannot be evicted, nor can she leave without permission, preserving the husband's right to reconcile during the iddah period. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that the home serves as the designated space for this transitional phase, balancing the rights of both parties.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Wuheyb Bin Hafs, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5th or 6th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) regarding the divorced woman, where she should wait’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘In her house, when it was a divorce with a reversion being for him, it is not for him that he should exit her, nor for her that she should go out until she fulfils her husband’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Wuhayb ibn Hafs from abu Basir who has said the following: “I once asked one of the two Imam, (abu Ja‘far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, about the case of a woman who is divorced and about where she counts her waiting period.

He (the Imam) said, ‘She completes it in her home if divorce is in a manner where he has the right to go back to her. He cannot send her out and it is not for her to go out until waiting period is complete.’” It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jabalah from Ali ibn abu Hamzah and Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir a similar Hadith.
